AUGUST 30, 2026 · 1 MIN

Hello, world

This is the first note from the WuBu desk. There is no schedule and no content calendar. When something is worth writing down — a decision we argued about, a bug that taught us something, a release that finally landed — it will show up here.

What this is for

Mostly it is a build log. We are two people making Mac utilities and iPhone games slowly, and most of what we learn along the way disappears into a chat window. Writing it down forces us to know why we did things.

Expect posts about:

  • Decisions we reversed, and what it cost to reverse them.
  • Small Mac details — window behaviour, menu bar manners, the things you only notice when they are wrong.
  • Release notes with actual reasons behind the changes.

How this blog works

Every post is a markdown file in posts/, named for its topic and date:

posts/hello-world-2026-08-30.md

No database, no build step, no CMS. Write the file, run the index script, push. If you are the kind of person who enjoys that sentence, you will probably enjoy the apps too.

The list is short on purpose, and it moves at the speed two people can move without hating it.

More soon. Probably not that soon.
